goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Chancen und Risiken der Digitalisierung für Arbeit und Gesellschaft diskutieren.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A worker weighs digital assistance and remote cooperation against issues of time, further training and security. The neutral paired trays make deliberation clear without guaranteeing job gains, inevitable job loss or asserting that every digital tool is safe.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px robot/remote meeting, training book, clock and lock remain large and clear alongside the main title.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the selected opportunities and response/risk considerations are recognizable without quantitative claims.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The displayed laptop screen faces the audience as a conceptual presentation, not as a reversed screen being used by the central actor. The trays are illustrative weighing symbols.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The icons introduce questions. The security lock and training book are considerations/needs, not proof that security is already guaranteed or a full list of digital risks.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
